headline: Banco Itaú Colombia Incurs $115 Million Loss During Corporate Banking Shift
summary: Banco Itaú recorded losses of 479.18 billion COP ($115 million) as it executed a major retail banking asset transfer to Banco de Bogotá to focus exclusively on commercial corporate clients.
why: Itaú Unibanco is South America's largest private banking group, operating subsidiaries across major Latin American markets.

impacts.name: Itaú Unibanco
impacts.why: Restructuring charges and asset disposal losses hurt quarterly subsidiary financial performance.
